name: Open the window and mount the editor UI from Nox
body: `apps/world-editor/nox/src/main.nox` opens an SDL3 window, loads the Inter font, hands `BridgeHost` the clipboard, icon and image backends and an overlay host, sets the default font size to 12, and mounts `EditorApplication` from `apps/world-editor/src/ui`. Each frame it passes the window state (logical size, DPI, pointer, primary and secondary buttons), runs the bridge, lays out, handles input and draws the root and overlays. It answers the editor's window requests: title, size, text input and the SDL3 open and save dialogs (`src/FileDialogs.nox`).

comments.text: File dialogs tested under Xvfb with zenity: File > Save As opens the dialog with the World files filter in the world's folder and saves the world to the typed path; Cancel leaves the editor running and saves nothing. Exit after interaction is clean once nyx-scripting-language #5 is in (it panicked on a held host function before).
